description: Versioned named areas for the Grodno Guide. Single source for area resolution (RU/EN names + aliases) and for the project-area geofence predicate (agent.areas.in_project_area, re-exported by agent.geofence.inside_project_area). Geometry is referenced from the border files in this directory, never duplicated and never invented: areas whose boundary polygon does not exist in backend/data/ carry geometry=null, and containment for them is unknown (agent.areas.area_contains returns None) — an explicit unknown, never a silent default.
notes: District names are taken verbatim from the district column of places_region.csv; English district names are literal translations of the official Russian names.
grodno-oblast geometry is the geoBoundaries ADM1 polygon (grodno_border.json, Creative Commons Attribution 3.0), loaded at runtime from that file.

Boundary exceptions (points treated as inside the project area although they fall outside a border polygon) are the documented keep-list in belarus_border_keep.json; they are loaded into the grodno-oblast definition at runtime.
